name: Texture Buffer Object for Block Types
aliases: Texture Buffer Object for Block Types — TBO color lookup
definition: A technique to store block type colors in a Texture Buffer Object (TBO) and bind it as a texture to allow the vertex shader to look up colors based on the block type index stored in the vertex data.
summary: A Texture Buffer Object maps a GPU buffer to a texture for efficient, padding-free read-only lookup of block types via sampling, avoiding the overhead of SSBOs or UBOs.
